purpose: Teach: 尋常/行き着く/電報/航路/探知/重傷/覇権/代議士

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、尋常ではない、絶対、状況、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派
lines.en: Ren — your paper on wartime communications was remarkably thorough. Truly impressive work.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Lean forward slightly. Eyes engaged but not intense. Pause before the compliment—she means it. Clear, steady delivery without rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史的、本気で、絶対、最終的に、絶対、行き着く、絶対、結論、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to trace how those conclusions emerged historically, step by step. The research was demanding, but I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful. Slight hesitation on 'I tried'—modest but not false. Genuine gratitude in the final phrase. Even pace, grounded, no performance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、電報による、絶対、通信、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled telegram communications during that period—you really covered the scope well. It shows real intellectual generosity.
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking aloud. Slight nod of the head. Warm but professional distance. The compliment lands because she's being specific, not general.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、敵国の航路、絶対、避けた、絶対、船、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. I looked at how ships navigated around enemy routes, the logistics of it all. It was complicated history to work through, but I wanted to understand it properly. Thank you for believing in the project.
lines.style: Earnest, methodical. Slight breathiness when discussing the complexity. Ends with real vulnerability—the gratitude is unguarded. Quiet, sincere close.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、敵の探知、絶対、技術、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The sections on enemy detection technology were particularly insightful. You clearly gave that real consideration.
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Slight lean in engagement. Deliberate pace on 'insightful'—she's confirming something she noticed. Warm professional regard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、市民、絶対、重傷、絶対、状況、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、辛い歴史、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. Those sections on civilian casualties—the suffering during wartime—that was the hardest part to research with respect and honesty. I wanted to get it right.
lines.style: Quieter, more careful. Weight in the voice on 'hardest part.' Slight pause before 'with respect'—he's choosing words precisely. Solemn but not heavy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、覇権争い、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you examined the power struggles, the hegemonic conflicts underneath it all—you didn't shy away from complexity.
lines.style: Reflective, like she's assembling the thought as she speaks. Slight upward tilt at 'complexity'—genuine intellectual respect. Warm, measured, professorial.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、代議士の役割、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I focused on the role of Diet members in those decisions, how policy shaped everything on the ground. It required deep research, and I'm really grateful for your guidance throughout.
lines.style: Clear, organized thinking. Slight earnest emphasis on 'really grateful.' Ending with genuine warmth—not reflexive politeness. Even pace, present, unguarded close.
